meta_description: This CAFÉ™ commercial style range is inspired by professional kitchens, so you can entertain crowds of any size. Enjoy unmatched versatility with a cooktop that has it all, from Inspiral and Multi-Ring burners that evenly heat any cookware, to Griddle Zone burners—the perfect grilling accessory. The Caterer’s Oven fits a full-size catering pan and comes complete with Precision Cooking modes and an accompanying temperature probe for stunning results, no matter the dish.
